app.name: MuxMultiTool
app.tagline: A self-hostable ffmpeg GUI for lossless cutting, remuxing and stream selection.

theme.noToggle: {family} has one variant; pick another family in Settings

help.title: Help
help.body: Keyboard shortcuts and a short guide per screen appear here once the editors exist. Until then, every screen explains which feature it is waiting for.

codes.internal: The backend hit an internal error

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Every operation that writes output shows up here with its progress and log.

connection.reconnecting: The connection to the job queue was lost. Reconnecting…

detail.noRawOutput: ffmpeg wrote nothing before it stopped.
detail.logEmpty: ffmpeg has not written anything yet.
detail.command: The exact command this job runs
detail.commandPending: The command arrives with the job details.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this job?
cancelDialog.running: {name} is running. ffmpeg stops now and whatever it has written so far stays on disk.
cancelDialog.queued: {name} is waiting in the queue and will be removed from it.

filePicker.title: Choose files
filePicker.description: Browse the media folders and choose what to open.
filePicker.descriptionDirectory: Browse the media folders and choose one.
filePicker.noMatches: No files of the accepted types here ({extensions}).

files.description: Browse the media folders, select files by wildcard and read the per-stream report.

streams.description: Pick the streams to keep, apply filter rules by language, codec or id, and preview the ffmpeg command.

combine.description: Copy streams between files and build one output from several sources.

cut.description: Player, timeline with thumbnails and waveform, segments, keyframe, normal and smart cut.
cut.empty: Open a file to edit it: the preview plays on top, the timeline with thumbnails, waveform, segments and keyframes sits under it, and the segment list and cut settings follow.

images.description: GIF, snapshots, cover art and lossless crop.

batch.description: Apply an operation to every matching file in a folder, with a filename template and a preview.

presets.description: Saved operations, reusable from every screen.

settings.description: Appearance, shortcuts, paths and the ffmpeg capability check.
settings.markLight: Use {variant} when the system is light
settings.markDark: Use {variant} when the system is dark
settings.autoHint: Follows the OS: {light} when the system is light, {dark} when it is dark.
settings.sameVariantHint: A family without a light variant uses the same variant for both.
settings.later: Material and GitHub follow after the MVP.
settings.saveError: The theme could not be saved on the server; it is kept in this browser only.

tree.label: Folders
tree.noRoots: No media folders are configured. Mount one and set MMT_MEDIA_ROOTS.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.hint: Wildcards: * any run, ? one character, [abc] one of a set. Several patterns separated by spaces.
pattern.added: {n} file added ({matched} matched) | {n} files added ({matched} matched)

table.caption: {folder} · {files} file · {selected} selected | {folder} · {files} files · {selected} selected
table.selectAll: Select every file in this folder
table.name: Name
table.empty: No media files in this folder.

report.title: Stream report · {n} file | Stream report · {n} files
report.empty: Select files above, or by wildcard, to see their streams here.
report.measureHint: Reads every selected file once to sum the packets of each stream. Sizes marked ~ are estimates.
report.pending: Waiting for the report of {n} file… | Waiting for the reports of {n} files…
report.selectStream: Show the details of stream {index} of {name}

details.title: Details · {name} #{index}
details.empty: Click a stream in the report to see everything ffprobe knows about it.

merge.description: Join files with identical codecs without re-encoding, after a compatibility check.
merge.needTwo: Select at least two files to merge.
merge.resolve: Resolve {n} problem first | Resolve {n} problems first

order.title: Order
order.empty: No files yet. Select files on the Files screen, or add them here.

check.title: Compatibility check
check.droppedNote: {n} stream left out of the merge. This stays lossless. | {n} streams left out of the merge. This stays lossless.

output.title: Output
output.hint: A full path, or a file name next to the first file. Empty uses the placeholder name. The file must not exist yet.

images.empty: Open a file, or select one on the Files screen, to take a snapshot, set cover art, make a GIF or crop black bars.
images.cropDisabled: Crop is disabled for this file: {reason}

output.label: Output filename
output.hint: A file name next to the input, or a full path. The file must not exist yet.

job.showFailed: The folder could not be opened: {detail}

snapshot.description: Full-resolution frame at the playhead, decoded from the original file.
snapshot.previewFailed: No frame could be decoded at this position.
snapshot.writes: Saves {png} or {jpg} next to the file.

cover.description: Embed the frame at the playhead as the file's cover art, on a copy with every stream kept as it is.
cover.containers: Only MKV and MP4 outputs can hold cover art; the output's extension decides.

gif.description: A GIF from the selected range. State the limits; the scale and palette options follow, and the estimate shows before anything runs.
gif.unsupported: This ffmpeg build cannot make GIFs: it lacks {missing}
gif.rangeHint: Set the range with I and O on the player; without one the GIF starts at the beginning, up to the duration limit.
gif.toVideo: This file is a GIF: convert it to a video without audio instead.
gif.noEncoder: This ffmpeg build has no encoder for {format}

crop.title: Crop · {codec} {width}×{height}
crop.unsupported: Lossless crop is not possible for this file: {reason}
crop.found: Found: top {top}, bottom {bottom}, left {left}, right {right} (scanned {frames} frames)
crop.detectHint: Pick a bright frame so auto-detect sees the real edges.
crop.unit: Values snap to {x} px across and {y} px down ({pixFmt})
crop.nothing: Nothing to crop yet: set a side, drag an edge on the picture, or auto-detect.

engine.label: {engine}
engine.none: This browser cannot decode H.264/AAC through MediaSource and has no HLS player of its own, so the preview cannot play. On Linux Firefox, install the system ffmpeg libraries (libavcodec); otherwise use another browser.

player.fatal: Playback failed: {detail}. Reopen the file to start the preview again.

transport.noKeyframes: Keyframe positions are not known for this file yet
transport.timecode: Current timecode; type a time such as 1:02:03.456 and press Enter to seek

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Fixed shortcuts; they work while no text field has the focus.

streams.description: Tick streams to keep or drop, filter by language, codec or stream id, or extract tracks to files; the streams are copied, never re-encoded.
streams.empty: No files yet. Select files on the Files screen, or add them here.
streams.extractNote: Extraction writes every ticked stream to a file of its own. Rules do not apply here; untick what you do not want.
streams.resolve: Resolve the issues in {n} file first | Resolve the issues in {n} files first

rules.title: Rules
rules.applyTo: apply to {n} file | apply to all {n} files
rules.empty: No rules yet: every stream is kept. Rules apply to every file; the ticks below override them per file.
rules.videoOnlyNote: Video only: audio, subtitles, attachments and data are dropped; the rules are not applied.

output.title: Output
output.folderHint: An absolute folder inside a media root. Empty puts the output next to its input.
output.templateHint: {'{name}'} is the input's name without extension, {'{ext}'} the container's extension. The file must not exist yet.
output.extractNames: The files are named after the input, the stream and its codec, e.g. clip.s1.audio.eng.aac; existing files are never overwritten.

command.title: Command · {name}
command.none: The command appears once the preview is in.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Fixed shortcuts; they work while no text field has the focus.

actions.toggleStream: Tick / untick stream #0 – #9 of the active file
actions.resetTicks: Reset the active file's ticks to the rules

combine.description: Build one file from streams of several sources: add English subtitles from another file, or video from one release with audio from another. Streams are copied, never re-encoded.
combine.needTrack: Add at least one track from a source.
combine.resolve: Resolve {n} problem first | Resolve {n} problems first

sources.title: Sources
sources.empty: No sources yet. Select files on the Files screen, or add them here.

tracks.title: Output tracks
tracks.empty: No tracks yet. Add streams from the sources on the left.
tracks.defaultOf: Track {track} is the default of its kind

output.hint: {'{name}'} is source A's name without extension, {'{ext}'} the container's extension. The file must not exist yet.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Fixed shortcuts; they work while no text field has the focus. The track shortcuts act on the last clicked track.

status.error: The project could not be saved
status.changed: Project saved ✓ · the file changed since the segments were saved; check that they still fit
status.missing: Project saved ✓ · the file is no longer where it was

actions.addHint: A segment from the player's range (set with I and O), or from the playhead to the end (A)
actions.splitHint: Split the segment under the playhead in two (S)

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.snapHint: Snap segment edges to keyframes and the playhead; hold Alt while dragging to skip it
timeline.dragHint: Drag here to create a segment
timeline.scrollHint: Drag to scroll; Ctrl + wheel zooms

segments.title: Segments
segments.empty: No segments yet. Drag on the timeline's segment lane, set a range in the player with I and O and add it, or use Split…
segments.goTo: Go to the start of segment {n}
segments.typeHint: Type a time such as 12:34.5, 0:12:34.567, 1h2m3s or 754.5 and press Enter

errors.pastEnd: The time is past the end of the file.
errors.startAfterEnd: The end must be after the start.

mode.keepHint: Export the segments; the rest is dropped.
mode.keyframeHint: Lossless: each part starts at the last keyframe before its start, so nothing after the start is lost and up to one GOP is added in front.
mode.normalHint: Lossless: each part starts exactly at its start; the picture joins at the next keyframe, so it can stay black for up to one GOP.
mode.smartHint: Frame-accurate: the frames around each cut are re-encoded with the source's codec, everything else is copied.
mode.smartChecking: Checking whether this file can be smart cut…
mode.smartSummary: Re-encodes ~{seconds} s around {points} cut points ({encoder}). The rest is copied losslessly.

export.title: Export as
export.mergedHint: The parts are joined with the concat demuxer; needs a video stream and a container that seeks by keyframe.
export.outputHintSeparate: A template inside a media root: {'{n}'} is the part number, {'{start}'} and {'{end}'} its times; a name without a placeholder gets {'-{n}'}. The files must not exist yet.
export.outputHintMerged: A file inside a media root; without an extension it takes the input's. It must not exist yet.

plan.title: Plan
plan.none: Add a segment and an output to see where the cuts land and the command that will run.

split.title: Split the file
split.body: Replaces the segments with parts cut at keyframes: by a longest duration, a largest size or a number of parts. Review them on the timeline before exporting.

errors.duration: Type a duration such as 10:00 or 600.
errors.count: Type a whole number of parts from 2 to 1000.

shortcuts.title: Timeline shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Fixed shortcuts for the timeline and segments; the player's own are behind its keyboard button.

actions.addSegment: Add a segment from the range, or from the playhead
actions.splitAtPlayhead: Split the segment under the playhead

segment.title: With a segment focused (Tab to the segment lane)
segment.start: Move its start by a frame
segment.end: Move its end by a frame
